title: Editor Text Block Editing UX Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor, Backend, and Core boundary context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, Work path, owner repository, terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, Core AGENTS.md, Backend AGENTS.md, and the bounded visible text-block editing UX target are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor with bounded repo-backend/repo-core references, phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-text-block-editing-ux, checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-text-block-editing-ux, and evidence target evidence-editor-text-block-editing-ux-2026-08-31 before edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor tests before changing text-block editing UX behavior.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests fail before dirty-state cleanup, save-rejection recovery, multiline row display, live smoke fixture update, and Core v4 line-break normalization are implemented.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included focused Editor failures for draft clean-state return, rejection clearing after a new edit, stale live smoke multiline fixture expectations, paper textarea rows/status data, and raw CR/LF text-run replacement before line-break atomic normalization existed.

items.label: Normalize textarea hard line breaks into Core document v4 inline atomics.
items.evidenceTarget: The Editor text-block inline draft adapter stores hard line breaks as document v4 line-break inline children and reconstructs multiline textarea text from text plus line-break atomics.
items.verificationNote: Editor commit a42409a31cb855331e5114a52bc3d07d75cb67e6 updates textBlockInlineDraftAdapter to expose the editable text/line-break range, split textarea CR/LF into Core v4 line-break atomics, preserve trailing field-ref children, and read multiline text back from inline atomics.

items.label: Harden dirty-state and rejected-save recovery for the active text-block island.
items.evidenceTarget: Drafts become clean when their inline children match the Backend value again, and rejected save state clears after the user makes another edit.
items.verificationNote: useActiveTextBlockEditing compares normalized draft children against the Backend source children and disables Save when they match; activeTextBlockIsland replacement accepts status override so a new edit clears lastRejected and returns to dirty local state.

items.label: Render bounded multiline textarea rows and visible editing status.
items.evidenceTarget: PaperTextBlockEditor exposes bounded row count, dirty/pending data state, and status text for unsaved, blocked, or failed save states without contenteditable.
items.verificationNote: PaperTextBlockEditor adds resolveTextBlockTextareaRows with hard-line and soft-wrap bounds, data-text-block-dirty and data-text-block-pending attributes, and a status label while preserving the existing textarea island rather than switching to contenteditable.

items.label: Prove multiline save and reload through a live local Backend browser smoke.
items.evidenceTarget: The browser smoke types multiline text through the visible textarea, saves by text-block.rich-inline.replace, reloads from Backend api transport, reconstructs the multiline value, and records rows after typing and reload.
items.verificationNote: The updated live smoke uses browser text insertion for Visible text block editor plus three lines, records textareaRowsAfterTyping and textareaRowsAfterReload as 4, reconstructs saved text from text and line-break inline children, and still verifies contentEditableCount 0.

items.label: Run worktree and merged-main Editor gates and record cleanup state honestly.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor worktree and merged main pass focused tests, full check, and no-write live Backend browser smoke; cleanup risks remain explicit.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree and merged main passed the focused 5-file/18-test gate, npm run check with 102 test files and 354 tests plus build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke.
